findings.problem: close's owned walk (docs/work/<slug>/, story) skips the secret filter: an ignored .env/*.pem/*.key/credentials.* there is hashed (opened) and copied into the main tree.
findings.scenario: The track holds docs/work/demo-1.1/.env; close demo-1.1 opens it, writes it into main's docs/work/demo-1.1/.env and prints copied.
findings.closure: Closure: a KT case puts .env, x.pem, x.key, credentials.json under the track's docs/work/demo-1.1/; after close they are absent from main and from the report; the owned list goes through SECRET_RE (not SESSION_DOCS, handoff.md still comes back).

findings.problem: Copy-back follows a main-side symlink (destination file or a parent dir): shutil.copyfile's follow_symlinks only governs src, place() treats a symlink destination as None==None unchanged, and no parent is checked.
findings.scenario: After fork, main's docs/work/demo-1.1/notes.md is a symlink to a file outside the project; the track writes notes.md; close overwrites the link target and reports copied.
findings.closure: Closure: close exits 2 and writes nothing when any copy destination or any of its parents below the root is a symlink; KT cases with a symlinked destination file and a symlinked docs/work/<slug> assert the target unchanged and the worktree intact.

findings.problem: A kit-local track merged by 4bis-local (no remote) is never closed: item 3 forbids the track session from closing but gives it no hand-over, and the closing checks only scan awaiting-merge handoffs through loop-pr-state.sh, which never prints closable without a remote.
findings.scenario: Kit-local project, no origin: the track session merges feat/x-1.1 locally; nothing tells the user to run close from the main tree and no closing check picks it up; story stays InProgress, worktree and docs/work/x-1.1/ stay behind.
findings.closure: Closure: 4bis-local item 3's kit-local branch has the track session write handoff phase: awaiting-merge and print the exact main-tree command (kit-track.py close <slug>, no --merged); the closing check (orchestrate Phase 0 step 0, tracks step 0) closes a kit-local worktree handoff at awaiting-merge whose branch is already an ancestor of the main tree's HEAD without loop-pr-state.sh; contract cases pin both.

findings.problem: KT7's secret rows can never fail: the fixture's secrets sit at the project root, which candidates() never walks, so removing SECRET_RE leaves the suite green.
findings.scenario: SECRET_RE check deleted at kit-track.py:91; a project with .claude/.env or docs/work/x/credentials.json gets it copied into the worktree; every KT stays green.
findings.closure: Closure: the KT7 fixture puts .env, .env.local, x.pem, x.key, credentials.json inside walked folders (.claude/ and docs/work/old/) and asserts each absent from the worktree; the case is red when the SECRET_RE check is removed.

findings.problem: Vigilance F12 (file absent from the manifest but present in main → sidecar, never overwrite) has no case; a defect treating 'not in manifest' as unchanged stays green.
findings.scenario: Main writes docs/work/demo-1.1/research.md after the fork while the track writes its own; with place() mutated to overwrite, close replaces main's file and every KT stays green.
findings.closure: Closure: a KT case where main gains docs/work/demo-1.1/research.md with different content after the fork; after close main keeps its content, research.md.from-demo-1.1 holds the track's, and the output reports conflict docs/work/demo-1.1/research.md.

findings.problem: The /clear next-feature hook skips only small-* worktrees; a kit-local track session (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR = the worktree) reads its snapshot board and offers the topmost READY story, often a sibling track.
findings.scenario: Kit-local tracks inbox-1.2 and inbox-1.3 forked; /clear in the 1.3 session offers inbox 1.2; on go, story 1.2 is built on feat/inbox-1.3.
findings.closure: Closure: the hook prints nothing when the project dir is a .claude/worktrees/<name> tree holding .claude/.kit-snapshot; a hook fixture case with a source: clear payload in such a tree asserts empty output.

findings.problem: fork has no rollback: an OSError during copy after git worktree add escapes as a traceback (exit 1) leaving a worktree and branch with a partial kit and no .kit-snapshot; a malformed .kit-snapshot crashes close with JSONDecodeError.
findings.scenario: ENOSPC mid-copy: settings.json copied before hooks; the half kit fails open; close then refuses it.

findings.problem: The local-kit-env slot invites a per-track test-database env line, which may carry a credential, printed verbatim by an auto-allowed command.
findings.scenario: A DATABASE_URL with a password in the slot lands in the transcript at every fork.

findings.problem: Leftover EnterWorktree / remove wording not scoped to the versioned path: tracks.md:187-208 (this session enters at most one, hand-over block without the cd && ./workflow.sh line) and orchestrate.md:258-259; 'Otherwise, on go' reads as if the kit-local fork needs no go.
findings.scenario: An agent following the later line EnterWorktrees into a kit-local track with the main tree's CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.

findings.problem: Kit-local close runs before step 5's precondition (main tree on the synced default branch) is checked; a stop after close leaves the pass half-closed.
findings.scenario: Main tree on another pass's branch: close removes the tree, step 5 reports and stops, the next closing check mistakes the copied handoff for a main-tree one.

findings.problem: A third copy of the runtime/session list, already missing .ruff_cache/, project.snapshot.json, project.proposed.json, .loop-record.*.tmp (spurious kit drift lines); the kit-local probe now has three code copies.
findings.scenario: A project.proposed.json left in .claude/ is copied to tracks and reported as drift at close.

findings.problem: walk refuses symlinks before the ignored/skipped filters (a tracked CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md link or a linked settings.local.json blocks the fork), and prunes SKIP_DIRS in docs/ folders too.
findings.scenario: A versioned CLAUDE.md symlink makes every fork refuse.

findings.problem: A kit-local track session is never told it is the track (.claude/.kit-snapshot as the cue): Phase 0.5 may try fork (refused), step 4 / kit-attempts --board write the snapshot board; the Phase 0.5 hand-over meets step 4's give-back rule; the 4bis-PR sentence omits 'main-tree session'.
findings.scenario: A blocked track writes BLOCKED into its snapshot board; main never learns it.

findings.problem: Test gaps: KT6 not verbatim (no stop at next heading, FILL branch untested), copy-set inclusions partly asserted (.size-exempt, workflow-routing.yml, PRODUCT/DESIGN, docs/specs|prd|architecture|design-system), *.pyc rule untested alone, KT11 misses '..' check, base branch always main, KT18 no exit/removal check, KT20 new snapshot file, WT5 hand-over, WT6 ordering, untested refusals (from a worktree, detached HEAD, missing snapshot, verify mismatch, remove failure); KT17 pre-GREEN correction not recorded in ## Gate.
findings.scenario: Dropping docs/specs from DOC_DIRS stays green.

findings.problem: github.md 'Merging a track back' has no kit-local line (refuted as a live failure: the track session stands in its tree and item 3 routes close to the main tree), so a main-tree request to integrate a kit-local track would remove it bare.
findings.scenario: A main session asks the github agent to clean up feat/x-1.1 of a kit-local track; steps 5-6 remove the tree without sidecars or drift report.
